% Default options of the Matlab function flux_constraints_default_options.m (Metabolic Network Toolbox),
% used by flux sampling and thermodynamic functions of the Metabolic Network Toolbox and by STM (stm_default_options).
% Empty values: option is empty by default ([] in Matlab). Flags: 1 (true) or 0 (false).
% The options are stored in two Matlab structs, 'options' and 'constraints' (prefixes of the IDs).
% For vectors (nr: number of reactions; nm: number of metabolites), the value given is used for all elements.
